headline: Coca-Cola (KO) Will Supply Drinks At KFC U.S. Starting In 2027
summary: KFC U.S. has selected Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) as its exclusive beverage supplier, replacing PepsiCo across its U.S. restaurants. The new U.S. fountain partnership is set to begin in 2027, ending a multi decade relationship between KFC and PepsiCo. The agreement gives Coca-Cola expanded brand exposure within a major U.S. quick service chain as KFC refreshes its menu and drink lineup.
